claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Milrinone is a PDE3 inhibitor that raises cAMP/cGMP in cardiac and vascular cells but has no plausible cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen, so it is expected to be largely inactive.
